arxiv-1701-05441.description: Abstract Abstract This article, in a first step, considers two Bayes estimators for the relativity premium of a given Bonus–Malus system. It then develops a linear relativity premium that closes, in the sense of weighted mean square error loss, to such Bayes estimators.

arxiv-1902-04876.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Enamullah, S. Bhat, Seung-Cheol Lee, S. Bhattacharjee. We propose that Cu-substituted Fe 2 P, (Fe 1-x Cu x ) 2 P ( x ∼ 0.16 x\sim 0.16 ), to be an outstanding contender for the STT-MRAM application.

arxiv-2012-01300.title: Learning from others’ mistakes: Avoiding dataset biases without modeling them
arxiv-2012-01300.creator: Victor Sanh, Thomas Wolf, Yonatan Belinkov, Alexander M. Rush
arxiv-2012-01300.description: Abstract State-of-the-art natural language processing (NLP) models often learn to model dataset biases and surface form correlations instead of features that target the intended underlying task. Previous work has demonstrated effective methods to circumvent these issues when knowledge of the bias is available.

arxiv-2012-04211.title: Quantum Fully Homomorphic Encryption by Integrating Pauli One-time Pad with Quaternions
arxiv-2012-04211.creator: Guangsheng Ma, Hongbo Li
arxiv-2012-04211.description: Abstract Quantum fully homomorphic encryption (QFHE) allows to evaluate quantum circuits on encrypted data. We present a novel QFHE scheme, which extends Pauli one-time pad encryption by relying on the quaternion representation of SU(2). With the scheme, evaluating 1-qubit gates is more efficient, and evaluating general quantum circuits is polynomially improved in asymptotic complexity.

arxiv-2102-12229.title: Convergence in the maximum norm of ADI-type methods for parabolic problems
arxiv-2102-12229.creator: S. González-Pinto and D. Hernández-Abreu
arxiv-2102-12229.description: Abstract Results on unconditional convergence in the Maximum norm for ADI-type methods, such as the Douglas method, applied to the time integration of semilinear parabolic problems are quite difficult to get, mainly when the number of space dimensions m m is greater than two.

arxiv-2107-08252.title: Constraint Answer Set Programming: Integrational and Translational (or SMT-based) Approaches
arxiv-2107-08252.creator: YULIYA LIERLER University of Nebraska Omaha
arxiv-2107-08252.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by YULIYA LIERLER University of Nebraska Omaha. Constraint answer set programming or CASP, for short, is a hybrid approach in automated reasoning putting together the advances of distinct research areas such as answer set programming, constraint processing, and satisfiability modulo theories. Constraint answer set programming demonstrates promising results, including the development of a multitude of solvers: acsolver , clingcon , ezcsp , idp , inca , dingo , mingo , aspmt2smt , clingo[l,dl] , and ezsmt .

arxiv-2407-17770.title: BotEval : Facilitating Interactive Human Evaluation
arxiv-2407-17770.creator: Hyundong Cho, Thamme Gowda, Yuyang Huang, Zixun Lu, Tianli Tong, Jonathan May
arxiv-2407-17770.description: Abstract Following the rapid progress in natural language processing (NLP) models, language models are applied to increasingly more complex interactive tasks such as negotiations and conversation moderations. Having human evaluators directly interact with these NLP models is essential for adequately evaluating the performance on such interactive tasks.

arxiv-2503-10239.title: I Can Tell Your Secrets: Inferring Privacy Attributes from Mini-app Interaction History in Super-apps
arxiv-2503-10239.creator: Yifeng Cai, Ziqi Zhang, Mengyu Yao, Junlin Liu, Xiaoke Zhao, Xinyi Fu, Ruoyu Li, Zhe Li, Xiangqun Chen, Yao Guo, Ding Li
arxiv-2503-10239.description: Abstract Super-apps have emerged as comprehensive platforms integrating various mini-apps to provide diverse services. While super-apps offer convenience and enriched functionality, they can introduce new privacy risks. This paper reveals a new privacy leakage source in super-apps: mini-app interaction history, including mini-app usage history (Mini-H) and operation history (Op-H).

pmc-12736313.title: Curcumin and Resveratrol vs. Ferrocene-Modified Polyphenols: Role in Enhancing Protective Properties in Human Keratinocytes
pmc-12736313.creator: Marina Miletić, Veronika Kovač, Lidija Barišić, Alen Supičić, Bruno Doskočil, Irena Landeka Jurčević, Jelka Pleadin, Branimir Šimić, Ivana Kmetič, Teuta Murati, Marta Szekalska, Lauryna Pudžiuvelytė
pmc-12736313.description: Background/Objectives: Resveratrol (RSV) and curcumin (CRC) have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, photoprotective, and cell-repairing properties. We selected them to investigate the potential role involved in human keratinocyte protection. Additionally, we tried to overcome the limitations of their application due to poor pharmacokinetics by introducing ferrocene into their structure.

pmc-13243715.title: A 11β-Hydroxysteroid Dehydrogenase Type 1 (11β-HSD1) Inhibitor, 11b-0048, Effectively Suppresses the Expression of 11β-HSD1 Activated in Cultured Keratinocytes and in Diabetic Murine Skin
pmc-13243715.creator: Ju Yeong Lee, Hyun Jee Hwang, Eunjung Kim, Jee-Young Lee, Seunghyun Kang, Eung Ho Choi
pmc-13243715.description: BackgroundElevated active glucocorticoids (GCs) are implicated in skin barrier dysfunction, notably in aging and diabetes. The enzyme 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 (11β-HSD1) converts inactive GCs to active forms, potentially exacerbating this dysfunction.ObjectiveWe aimed to investigate the impact of a novel 11β-HSD1 inhibitor on skin inflammation using both in vitro and in vivo models.

pmc-13423045.title: Peripancreatic Tuberculosis Mimicking Metastatic Pancreatic Malignancy With Hepatic Lesions
pmc-13423045.creator: Sorour Raeiskarimi, Gordafarin Nikbakht, Fariba Zarei
pmc-13423045.description: A 61-year-old woman presented with chronic constipation, epigastric pain, intermittent fever, night sweats, anorexia, and marked weight loss. Imaging showed porta hepatis and peripancreatic lymphadenopathy, small hepatic lesions, and a pancreatic-region lesion, raising concern for metastatic pancreatic malignancy or lymphoma. The initial liver biopsy was negative for metastatic carcinoma and lymphoma.

pmc-13472582.creator: P. B. Abinaya, Lavanya Dharmalingam, Siva Kaliyamoorthy
pmc-13472582.description: Background:Thyroid nodules are commonly detected with high-resolution ultrasonography.
